measurements.notes: The brief's prime suspect, confirmed — with the important twist that saves the safety argument: the failure is PREDICTABLE. Signature chain: Delphi window class -> all-Pane 52-node tree with zero interactive types -> router concludes 'structure = region map only; content = pixels' BEFORE answering any content question. The 15 region captions are genuinely useful (they name WHERE things are: Browser/Channel rack/Playlist/Mixer rects for targeted crops) — FL's minimal a11y layer is a area-map, not a content channel. What makes it silent rather than explicit: nothing distinguishes 'empty pane' from 'pane full of painted content' — the same shape a genuinely empty panel would produce. Timing note for honesty: the UIA walks ran while the welcome wizard was up; the PrintWindow ground truth was captured ~30 s later after the wizard auto-dismissed — both states show the same channel-vs-screen asymmetry (wizard: empty grid node over a painted recent-projects list; workspace: empty panes over a dense DAW UI).
